bands.note: Band shares use summed power over half-open ranges low [0,250), mid [250,2000), high [2000,8000), very_high [8000, analysed Nyquist]. The denominator is restricted to the source Nyquist. A band is null when it has no bins below that limit; coverage records the fraction of the nominal band width that was actually analysed. The exact source Nyquist bin belongs to the last available band only.

description.note: Absolute thresholds for the deterministic acoustic sheet. No track is ranked against another and no source identifier contributes vocabulary. When a measurement is unavailable the corresponding qualifier is omitted or stated as not measurable.

flux.note: Per-frame flux is the sum of positive changes of the L1-normalised magnitude spectrum. Flux of the first frame is zero. A peak is counted on an interior frame when flux is at least peak_threshold, strictly greater than the previous frame and at least the next frame. Rate is peaks divided by analysed duration in seconds.

loudness.note: Optional integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP) measured by ffmpeg loudnorm input_i/input_tp. Failures and silence leave both values null with a reason; they never abort extraction.

playback.note: Playback metadata copied to every track. trim_db is authored in the annotations file and must be finite and within [-24, 6]; a non-zero trim also requires trim_validated true. max_gain caps any future target gain; this is not automatic loudness compensation.

silence.note: A source is silent when its full-signal native RMS is at or below this threshold. Silence is detected before any spectral or temporal qualification; every derived measurement is then null with a reason.

spectrum.note: Native float32 samples are decoded once. Levels use the native rate; the spectrum uses resample_poly at sample_rate_hz. Hann is periodic (0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/N)). The final frame is zero padded and FFT work is bounded to block_frames frames. Spectral statistics only use bins up to the lower of the source Nyquist and the analysed Nyquist. Channel powers are averaged before magnitude is derived, so anti-phase channels cannot cancel. Frames at or below the silence threshold are excluded from spectral statistics. Flatness uses a relative epsilon times mean bin power. Zero-energy frames use rms_floor_dbfs in the RMS percentiles. Config numbers are consumed at six-decimal precision.
